description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No.02 of 2024
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of new excise regulations and rules under the Excise Ordinance, which constitutes legal/regulatory matters. It establishes new application procedures, fees, and licensing requirements for liquor sales, and explicitly rescinds previous notifications. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does so only in the context of his authority to make these regulatory changes under the ordinance, without detailing his ministerial portfolio responsibilities beyond his basic title. The core content is regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
